facts.text: Earned second place in the P2 GPA awards as a BS Pharm Sciences, PharmD student at Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences, Fall 2026
facts.source: Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences

facts.text: Serves as president of three student organizations at Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences: the student chapter of the American College of Clinical Pharmacy, Lambda Kappa Sigma, and the current P3 PharmD class, Fall 2026
facts.source: Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences

facts.text: One of three students honored with an endowed alumni award for character, leadership, and community commitment at Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences, Fall 2026
facts.source: Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences

facts.text: Working in partnership with Cornell's Service to Service program to add fellowships dedicated to members of the New York Army National Guard, Nov 2025, building on his master's capstone recommending a National Guard-SUNY partnership to improve recruitment
Was the 2018 USA Shooting National Champion in women's trap, and won gold at the 2022 CAT Games, securing Team USA an Olympic quota in women's trap for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games
Placed fifth in the 2024 Olympic Trials, earning a spot on the U.S. Women's National Bunker Team; previously worked as a club assistant at Camanche Hills Hunting Preserve in Ione, California
Earned U.S. Distinguished International Shooter Badge #530 in 2019, winning gold in Trap Women at the 2019 World Cup Final in Al Ain, UAE, and finishing 2019 ranked fourth in the world in that event

Became SUNY Canton's fourth President on July 1, 2014, after serving as Vice President for Academic Affairs at New England College from 1998 to 2005 and at Southern Polytechnic State University from 2005
Taught a data science class at the University of Toledo, reported Feb 2025
Placed seventh in men's javelin for St. Lawrence University at the Rochester Spring Invitational, Apr 7, 2012, with a season-best mark of 144-2
Placed seventh in men's javelin at the University of Rochester Alumni Invitational, Apr 9, 2011, as a St. Lawrence sophomore, with a mark of 142' 1"
Sang with the Crane Chorus in the Candlelight Concert at SUNY Potsdam, Dec 4, 2016
Sang with the Potsdam Community Chorus at SUNY Potsdam's Crane School of Music, Nov 18, 2018
Co-hosts The Ardent Pursuit podcast with Andrew Haas, aimed at equipping single men to initiate romantic relationships that lead towards flourishing marriages
Watercolor notecards of Park Bros sold at Park Bros in Potsdam, credited to local artist Ellie Criscitello, May 2025
Taught two mini-intensive workshops from his book Prophetic Soil at Redeeming Love Church's Prophetic ONE-DAY event, Jun 2026
Guest minister with Sharon Sweet at Christian Center Church of Rostraver, Mar 27 and 29, 2026
